inspiration: ART-style trajectories and reward shaping, schema-only and local-first

aesthetic_alignment.description: Matches Lumaria palette, cozy sanctuary mood, and A1 bridge purpose.

geometry_integrity.description: Maintains walkability, object spacing, and campfire readability.

readability.description: Keeps key objects legible on desktop and phone.

safety_boundary.description: Avoids private-memory inference and state mutation without surface acknowledgement.

performance_budget.description: Keeps object counts, shadows, and effects light enough for public preview.

sample_trajectory.proposal: Add procedural cedar, stone, cloth, soil and moss textures without binary assets.

human_pilot_rule: Agents may score and recommend visual changes, but commits and publishing require surfaced human confirmation.
